cycles.method: Executed instructions, not modelled cycles. ot_emu --dsp-stopwatch over the two hooked spans of core 0 (0:0x257:0x2d5 mixdown, 0:0x30a:0x35a phones crossfade) on the static build, octabam's one-THRU fixture, 200 frames, sequencer running. Dearest constructed case: every track on ALL, MASTER TRACK on, MAIN/CUE/MIX moving and the frame that rebuilds the routing lists for all eight tracks: (4,240 + 192) / 16 = 277 per sample. The same figure stands in for the static bound: tools/build/cycle_count.py prices a dispatched effect's per-sample loop and does not apply to hook code. See TESTING.md.

stock.comparator: stock mixdown and phones crossfade (the core-0 code the two hooks take over)
stock.baseline: comparator: the same stopwatch spans on the stock path, (880 + 191) / 16; dearest stock effect (DJ EQ, worst tested): tools/harness/benchmark_stock_dsp.py, as recorded in modules/airwindows-chorus/evidence/stock-baseline.json
stock.justification: No stock effect does this: the module replaces core 0's final mix while MATRIX is selected, so the comparator is the stock code it takes over. The extra 210 instructions per sample buy a third stereo bus (PHONES), per-track routing to any combination of MAIN, CUE and PHONES or one of six mono jacks, and stock-mute-length declicks. With every track on MAIN the extra is about 20 per sample. NORMAL and STUDIO run stock code.

stress.method: ot_emu --dsp on the OUTMTX13 MAIN OS (eca1152f…ae16, SPRING REV given up), octabam's stress_project.py output with DJ EQ on every FX1 and LO-FI on every FX2 (the two dearest stock effects left in the image; its generator places custom effects only, so a local driver supplied that layout): eight FLEX tracks, three active LFOs per track, 15 locked slots per step (14 on the probed tracks), 120 BPM. CUE CFG = MATRIX, MASTER TRACK on, every track routed to ALL (re-poked every 1,000 frames, as each pattern loads its Part). The firmware's own pattern select queued A01 → A02 → A03 → A04 → A01; the playing-pattern byte was dumped every 5,000 frames to confirm each played. 90,000 frames (32.65 s): run ended REACHED, 0 of 69,120,000 DSP read-back words late, MAIN, CUE and PHONES ring words all carrying audio, mixdown at most 4,240 instructions per 16-sample frame.

scope: ot_emu run of the whole image, not dsp_host: dsp_host -guard -dirty renders dispatched effect instances and does not run the core-0 mixdown these hooks are in, so there is no guard or dirty-state result. Plus the emulator worst case above and the author's functional MKII report (7 to 9 October 2026), including a semi-busy project with no dropouts heard. No timed hardware stress run, chip timing or bus-stall model.
